m: Slaw: shred the cabbage thin and toss with the juice of half the limes, coriander and salt.
Sauce: mayo, sriracha, sour cream and a squeeze of lime.
Cut the fish into fingers. Mix the flour with the paprika, cumin and 1 tsp salt, and toss the fish in it.
Shallow-fry in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes a side until golden and flaky. Drain on paper towel.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Load each taco with slaw, fish, avocado and sauce. Lime wedges on the side.
l: Turn it into a bowl: fish over rice and slaw, sauce on the side.
g: GF flour for the GF fish (fried first in fresh oil), and corn tortillas.
